== Biography ==
{{Ireland Native}}
{{Migrating Ancestor|origin= Ireland |destination= Australia|origin-flag= Flags-1.gif |destination-flag= Flags-5.png}}
Letitia was born about 1828. She was the daughter of [[Glasgow-2054|Samuel Glasgow]] and [[McCormick-8286|Ann McCormick]] 
<ref name="d"/>
of Gortin, Derryloran, County Tyrone.

She was Confirmed at Derryloran parish church in 1843, aged 15 years, resident of Gortin.
<ref>[[Space:The_Parish_Registers_of_Derryloran_parish_church|The Parish Registers of Derryloran parish church]] - Vol2</ref>

On 29 March 1855 at Derryloran parish church, she married Robert Samuel Brown, stonecutter of Crockatanty, Lower Bodoney, son of William Brown, farmer. Witnessed by John Ballantine and [[Glasgow-2538|Thomas M. Glasgow ]].
<ref>[https://civilrecords.irishgenealogy.ie/churchrecords/details-civil/70634e3247456 Robert Brown, Letitia Glasgow, 1855, Cookstown] at Irish Civil Registration - Marriages</ref>

They emigrated to Victoria, Australia with eldest daughter Mary Anne born there early in 1856.  Later, they made their way to New Zealand.

She passed away 2 February 1919 age 90 at the residence of her daughter Mrs. Thompson, 82 Jervois Rd, Auckland; formerly of Thames and Morrinsville.
<ref name="d">NZ BDM Death registration: 1919/671	Brown	Letitia McCormick	90Y</ref>
<ref>[https://paperspast.natlib.govt.nz/newspapers/AS19190203.2.112 "Deaths"], ''Auckland Star'', Volume L, Issue 29, 3 February 1919, Page 12</ref>
She is buried at Waikaraka Cemetery.
<ref>{{FindAGrave|163846201}}</ref>
== Research Notes ==
=== Individual father review, 22 October 2026 ===

This dated review supersedes any earlier grade of this pair within the stated record scope. The existing father [[Glasgow-2054]] is assessed at 98% (proved). The retained death-certificate transcription names Samuel Glasgow and Ann formerly McCormick. Letitia's 1843 Gortin confirmation and 1855 marriage place her in the same distinctive Samuel household.

Selected Glasgow-2054 fatherhood of Glasgow-2541; maternal identity and upstream ancestry are separate.

Next useful test: Compare the original NZ certificate and 1855 marriage father field.

Source basis already held: [https://www.wikitree.com/wiki/Glasgow-2541 NZ BDM Death registration: 1919/671 Brown Letitia McCormick 90Y]. No new father attached; cited evidence and any inspected register entry are scoped above.


Transcription of death certificate, {{Ancestry Tree Media|108104612|be5b6430-85c7-44f3-ac71-a7c5e8fcd3bf}}:
* Letita McCormick Brown, widow, 90 years.
* 2 February 1909, 82 Jervois Road, Ponsonby.
* Senile decay.
* Samuel Glasgow + Ann Glasgow formerly McCormick, gentleman.
* b. Tyrone, Ireland; 40 years in NZ.
* Married in Ireland at age 28 to Robert Samuel Brown.
* Living issue: F. 60(?), 44.

The first marriage witness might be [[Ballantine-348|John Ballantine (abt.1833-1902)]], of the same townland as her husband.
